stories.summary: Markle Sr's arrest follows an investigation launched after his son, Thomas Markle Jr, reportedly discovered boxes containing hundreds or potentially thousands of images at his father's former home in the Philippines.

stories.title: Texas mayor instructs police to limit co-operation with ICE
stories.summary: There has been months of public outcry in Houston after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer fatally shot a man who was driving to work.

stories.title: Pedro Alliana sworn in as Paraguay president after Santiago Peña's impeachment
stories.summary: Ousted ex-President Santiago Peña was placed under house arrest on Friday after he was impeached over a major banking crisis.

stories.title: Exercise coaching boosts colon cancer survival
stories.summary: Evidence suggests exercise can keep more cancer patients alive. But what does "living longer" actually mean, and who does it apply to?

stories.title: What to know about the IIHF Women's Ice Hockey World Championship
stories.summary: As ice hockey's governing body continues to wrangle over how to respond to a CAS order to reinstate Russia to international play, the top women's tournament gets underway in Denmark without Russia.

stories.title: Tesla to 'wind down' production of flop Cybertruck
stories.summary: Elon Musk's electric pickup for the future will start to be consigned to the past next year. The Cybertruck's bulk and crude shape meant it could only pass regulatory standards in more permissive markets.

stories.title: UK: Thousands gather as London switches on its Christmas lights
stories.summary: Thousands of people gathered on London's Regent Street on Thursday 5 November as the famous shopping destination welcomed the Christmas season with a spectacular lights switch-on and fireworks display.

stories.title: Kazakhstan’s growth to pick up in 2027 despite geopolitical tensions, IMF says
stories.summary: The IMF expects Kazakhstan’s economy to grow by 4.9% in 2027, up from 4.4% this year. Kazakhstan is forecast to grow faster than any other oil exporter in the IMF’s Middle East and Central Asia group in 2026.

stories.title: Iran delivers secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes gas pipeline deal
stories.summary: Iran’s Security Council chief, Mohsen Rezaei, went to Moscow to deliver a personal message from Ayatollah Khamenei and discuss building a pipeline to import Russian gas.

stories.title: Spain: Vintage cars hit the streets of Almería for annual rally
stories.summary: Around 40 vintage and classic cars have taken to the streets of Almería for the 36th edition of an annual rally. From a rare 1905 Vermorel to a DeLorean, the event celebrates more than a century of motoring history.

stories.title: Switzerland: Giant banner targets Big Tech outside data centre site
stories.summary: Greenpeace activists unfurled a giant 26-by-26-metre banner outside a data centre construction site in Beringen, northeastern Switzerland, on Friday 6 November, protesting against the growing environmental impact of major technology companies.
